physicalNotes: No radius or mass of the Shapley Supercluster is recorded: it is an extended supercluster of galaxies, and its package frames it at 21400000 pc (object.json worldFrame.bodyRadiusM), a presentation value: half the 30 h^-1 Mpc short side of the main plane Proust et al. (2006) measured, with h = 0.7.

sources.position: The X-ray centre of Abell 3558, one of the three clusters of the supercluster's core (Proust et al. 2006, https://arxiv.org/abs/astro-ph/0509903): Sadibekova et al. (2024), MCXC-II, A&A 688 A187; CDS J/A+A/688/A187, byte columns defined by https://cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/ftp/J/A+A/688/A187/ReadMe (https://cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/ftp/J/A+A/688/A187/mcxcii.dat.gz); catalogue reference mcxc-ii:MCXC J1327.9-3130
sources.distance: Tully et al. (2023), Cosmicflows-4, ApJ 944, 94; CDS J/ApJ/944/94, tables 2 (group membership, 1PGC) and 3 (group distance modulus, DMzp), as joined into the Nearby Universe's tracked table (https://cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/viz-bin/cat/J/ApJ/944/94); catalogue reference cosmicflows-4:47202: 189845365.666151 pc; Cosmicflows-4 group distance of Abell 3558's group: the weighted average of its members' distance moduli on the calibrated scale (table 3, DMzp).
sources.properMotion: Zero: the supercluster of galaxies is held at its published position; no motion across the sky is applied.
sources.radialVelocity: c z for Abell 3558's catalogued redshift z = 0.048: Sadibekova et al. (2024), MCXC-II, A&A 688 A187; CDS J/A+A/688/A187, byte columns defined by https://cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/ftp/J/A+A/688/A187/ReadMe (https://cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/ftp/J/A+A/688/A187/mcxcii.dat.gz); catalogue reference mcxc-ii:MCXC J1327.9-3130
